stage.doc: The infinite canvas every project renders into; only allowed as the root element, and holding `<scene>` children.

scene.doc: A scene: the clipped, playable frame a composition is made in, and the only element allowed directly under `<stage>`.

group.doc: `<group>` — a container: its box is the union of its children, and its transform, opacity, timing and effects apply to all of them.

rect.doc: `<rect>` — a box, the basic shape: filled with `fill` (or paint children), rounded with `cornerRadius`, and the base of a mask (`mask`).

video.doc: `<video>` — a video clip: `src`, placed in time with `start`/`end`, trimmed with `sourceIn`/`sourceOut`, and fitted into its box with `objectFit` (`cover` unless said otherwise).

image.doc: `<image>` — a still image (or a directory of frames): `src`, fitted into its box with `objectFit` (`contain` unless said otherwise).

audio.doc: `<audio>` — a clip with a sound and no picture.

text.doc: `<text>` — text: what it says is its children, and its color is `color` (not `fill`).

textRange.doc: `<textRange>` — a style override for a run of the parent `<text>`'s glyphs, a sub-entity like a paint: `start`/`end` address the run by character index into the text as written (before `textCase`), the rest is what ch…

sequence.doc: `<sequence>` — plays its children back to back in document order; a child's `transition` blends it into the next.

captions.doc: `<captions>` — timed captions drawn in a `preset` style, from a transcript `src` or from `<cue>` children.

adjustmentLayer.doc: `<adjustmentLayer>` — a layer that draws nothing of its own and transforms the clip below it: while the layer's own clip lasts, its transform composes onto that of the sibling directly beneath it in the stack.

diagramNode.doc: A selectable diagram node with its label rendered as part of the same source-backed editor entity.

diagramEquation.doc: A selectable mathematical statement or formula.

diagramAxis.doc: A selectable x/y coordinate system with deterministic ticks and labels.

diagramPlot.doc: A selectable plot of explicit data points, mapped through domain and range.

diagramCallout.doc: A labeled panel with a pointer aimed at a local target coordinate.

solidPaint.doc: `<solidPaint>` — a flat `color` fill of the parent's shape.

linearGradientPaint.doc: `<linearGradientPaint>` / `<radialGradientPaint>` — a gradient fill of the parent's shape, through its `<colorStop>` children.

radialGradientPaint.doc: `<linearGradientPaint>` / `<radialGradientPaint>` — a gradient fill of the parent's shape, through its `<colorStop>` children.

imagePaint.doc: `<imagePaint>` / `<videoPaint>` — an asset painted into the parent geometry's box, a paint child like a solid or a gradient (several stack in document order).

videoPaint.doc: `<imagePaint>` / `<videoPaint>` — an asset painted into the parent geometry's box, a paint child like a solid or a gradient (several stack in document order).

colorStop.doc: `<colorStop>` — one color of a gradient, at `offset` 0–1 along it.

stroke.doc: `<stroke>` — an outline of the parent's box (or glyphs), a sub-entity like a paint: `color`/`opacity` are its paint, `width`/`join`/`cap`/`miterLimit` its line style.

shadow.doc: `<shadow>` — a drop shadow beneath the parent's box (or glyphs): a blurred, offset copy of its silhouette in `color`.

effect.doc: `<effect>` — a filter over the parent's rendered pixels (its fills, strokes and children together), a sub-entity like a paint.

animation.doc: `<animation>` — one preset in/out animation of the node holding it, played over the clip's head or tail.

keyframeTrack.doc: `<keyframeTrack>` — the keyframes of one prop of the element holding it, as elements, so an editor moving a keyframe has an element to write it to.

keyframe.doc: `<keyframe>` — one keyframe of the `<keyframeTrack>` holding it.

marker.doc: `<marker>` — a named point on a scene's timeline.

cue.doc: `<cue>` — one caption line, valid only inside `<captions>`.

duck.doc: `<duck>` — hold one clip's level down while another one plays.

path.doc: `<path>` — a free vector figure in SVG path syntax.

ellipse.doc: `<ellipse>` — an ellipse inscribed in the element's box.

polygon.doc: `<polygon>` — a closed figure through a list of points.

lottie.doc: `<lottie>` — a Lottie/Bodymovin animation as a composition element.

lottieSlot.doc: `<lottieSlot>` — one editable value inside a Lottie animation.

htmlPaint.doc: `<htmlPaint>` — real DOM children, laid out at the parent's box size and drawn into it.

html.doc: `<Html>` — a rectangle whose intrinsic paint draws the given DOM children.

shaderPaint.doc: `<ShaderPaint>` — transforms the media paint directly below it.

surfacePaint.doc: `<surfacePaint>` — a canvas the element's `ref` draws into (`element` on the received node).

textAnimator.doc: `<textAnimator>` — moves a `<text>` one letter, word or line at a time.

repeater.doc: `<repeater>` — one element drawn many times, laid out by rule.

active.doc: Whether this element is the one the playhead, timeline, and capture operate on.
active.deprecated: Editor view state, as `selected` is; see there.

addAudio.doc: Scores the footage: a generated soundtrack for a clip that has none.

after.doc: The `id` of an element this one follows: its span begins where that one's ends, and `start` alongside it becomes the gap after it rather than a time in the scene.

amount.doc: How strong the preset is, in the preset's own measure: "fade" — how much of the opacity it covers, 0–1 (default 1); "grow" / "shrink" — how much smaller / larger it starts, as a scale (default 0.5, so from 50% / 150%)…

attack.doc: How long the level takes to give way, leading the clip.

blendMode.doc: Blend mode over what is below.

bpm.doc: The scene's tempo, in beats per minute.

by.doc: `id` of the element whose span drives the duck.

camera.doc: The editor's viewport: `[1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0]` is the origin at 100%.
camera.deprecated: Editor view state, not part of the composition: nothing rendered or exported depends on it.

cameraZ.doc: Moves the camera toward the copies, px; past them it flies through.

cap.doc: How the stroke ends open paths (text glyphs).

children.doc: Element children, plus `<Effect>` (filtering the group as a whole), `<Animation>` and `<KeyframeTrack>` children.
Paint children, stacked over the media paint created by `src`; `<Stroke>`, `<Shadow>`, `<Effect>`, `<Animation>` and `<KeyframeTrack>` children.
The text content, required; alongside it, `<TextRange>`, `<TextAnimator>`, paint, `<Stroke>`, `<Shadow>`, `<Effect>`, `<Animation>` and `<KeyframeTrack>` children.
`<Animation>` and `<KeyframeTrack>` children — what the layer's transform is animated with.
Effects, animations, keyframes, paints, strokes, and other supported children.
`<Keyframe>` children, in any order; they sort by `time`.
Paint, stroke, shadow, effect, animation and keyframe children.
HTML children — real DOM elements laid out by the browser at the parent geometry's box size and drawn into it (html-in-canvas).
`<keyframeTrack>` children over the unit props listed above.
One element child — the template — plus `<keyframeTrack>` and `<animation>` children.

clipHeight.doc: Height of the element's row in the timeline, px.
clipHeight.deprecated: Editor view state, as `selected` is; see there.

color.doc: Any CSS color: the glyph color on `<Text>`, the paint color on paints, strokes, shadows and color stops.
Any CSS color: the glyph color on `<Text>`, the paint color on paints, strokes, shadows and color stops.
Any CSS color; defaults to the editor's accent.

colorBy.doc: What picks each copy's blend toward `colorTo`: its place in the order, the ripple, or its depth.

colors.doc: Fills the caption preset's color slots in order; any CSS color, alpha is ignored.

colorTo.doc: A second colour the copies' fill blends toward, by `colorBy`.

columns.doc: Columns of a "grid" or "plane"; 0 picks a square.

delay.doc: Gap between the clip edge and the animation: after the head for "in", before the tail for "out".

distance.doc: How far it travels, px: the length of a slide (default 100), the drift of a "twist" (default 30).

draw.doc: Paints one frame from the knobs — see `SurfaceDraw`.

easing.doc: The curve it plays with, in place of the preset's own.
Shapes the segment to the next keyframe; ignored on the last.

end.doc: Parent-timeline time at which the node ends.
One past the last character of the run.

error.doc: Why this element's source never became an asset.

expanded.doc: Whether the timeline shows this element's keyframe rows below its clip.
expanded.deprecated: Editor view state, as `selected` is; see there.

fill.doc: Any CSS color, the node's intrinsic solid fill (drawn beneath any paint children); alpha is ignored — use `opacity`.

fontFamily.doc: A family available on the machine (`posterract fonts`).

frameRate.doc: Frames per second for a `src` naming a directory of numbered frames — a folder of pictures has a count, not a duration, so this is what says how long the clip runs (600 frames at 24 is 25 seconds, at 60 is 10).

hidden.doc: Excludes the element from rendering (and its audio from the mix) without removing it: it keeps its place in the timeline and its children.

inset.doc: How far in from the frame's edges a `place` sits, px: one number for both axes, or `[x, y]`.

keepAspectRatio.doc: Locks the box to its authored proportions: a resize of one bound drives the other, so the editor's handles and layout rows keep the ratio `width`:`height` has (or, with neither authored, the ratio the box currently ha…

label.doc: Optional caption drawn below the expression.

layoutTo.doc: A second layout the copies blend toward, copy for copy.

leading.doc: Line height as a multiple of each line's natural height.

letterSpacing.doc: Extra space between glyphs, px (negative tightens).

locked.doc: Protects the element in the editor: a locked layer cannot be dragged on the timeline and is left alone by a delete — a person's or an agent's.

loop.doc: What the track does after its last keyframe, for as long as the element is on screen: `loop` (or "repeat") plays first → last again and again, "pingpong" plays it there and back.
Repeat for the element's whole span rather than holding the last frame.

markers.doc: Draw a dot at every point in addition to the path.

mask.doc: Makes the rect a mask of its parent: it clips the parent (its fills, strokes and children show only inside the rect's box) instead of drawing.
Makes the path a mask of its parent — see `RectProps["mask"]`.
Makes the ellipse a mask of its parent — see `RectProps["mask"]`.
Makes the polygon a mask of its parent — see `RectProps["mask"]`.

miterLimit.doc: Miter length limit, as a ratio of the width.

morphTo.doc: A second figure to blend toward, as path data.

motionBlur.type: number | boolean | { shutter?: number | undefined; samples?: number | undefined; }
motionBlur.doc: Motion blur, the smear a real camera gives anything that moves while its shutter is open.

muted.doc: Excludes the node's audio from the mix; independent of `volume`.

name.doc: The slot's name in the Lottie file.

objectFit.doc: How the source maps into the box.

offsetX.doc: Render-time translation on top of `x`/`y`, px — moves the drawn content without changing the layout box (the property slide animations drive).
Where the shadow sits relative to the silhouette, px.

path.doc: Lays the text along a path instead of in lines, as path data in the element's own coordinates: every glyph sits on the curve, turned to follow it.

pathAlign.doc: Which part of the text sits at `pathOffset`.

pathOffset.doc: How far along the path the text sits, as a fraction of its length; wraps on a closed path.

pathShift.doc: Moves the text off the path, px — outward is positive on a clockwise circle.

perspective.doc: How far the camera a tilt is seen through stands from the element, px (default 2000): nearer is a stronger 3D look, 0 none (the element only foreshortens).
Focal length, px: 0 is flat (orthographic); around 800 looks natural.

phase.doc: "in" plays from the clip's head, "out" into its tail.

place.doc: Where the element belongs in its scene's frame, instead of `x`/`y`: `place="bottom-right"` puts its bottom right corner on the frame's, `place="lower-third"` centres it on the line two thirds of the way down.

playbackRate.doc: Speed multiplier for the node's local time, 1 = normal: at 2, twice the source plays in the same stretch of timeline.

points.doc: `"x,y x,y …"` in the element's own coordinates.

progress.doc: 0–1 reveal amount used for agent-authored draw-on animation, clamped to that range.

property.doc: Which prop of the holding element the track animates.

radius.doc: Size of a circle, sphere, torus ring, cube (half its edge), spiral or random cloud, px.

release.doc: How long it takes to come back.

removeBackground.doc: Cuts the subject out, leaving the rest of the picture transparent.

ripple.doc: Height of a wave travelling through the copies: px of depth, or a size factor with `rippleMode="scale"`.

rippleCenterX.doc: Where the wave starts, px from the layout's centre.

rippleMode.doc: What the wave moves: depth ("z", the default) or the copies' size ("scale").

ripplePhase.doc: Where the wave is, in radians — keyframe it to make the wave travel.

rotationX.doc: 3D tilt in degrees, about the element's middle: `rotationX` tips the top away (90 is edge-on), `rotationY` turns the right side away.

scale.doc: Uniform scale about the box origin, 1 = natural size.

seed.doc: Seed of the "random" layout and the "random" stagger order.

selected.doc: Whether the editor has this element selected.
selected.deprecated: Editor view state, not part of the composition: nothing rendered or exported depends on it.

size.doc: The second number the finishing effects take: the grain's size in px, how far a vignette reaches (0–1), a glow's radius in px.

skill.doc: The skill this scene is made with: the `name` of a skill folder (a SKILL.md with its assets), chosen from the editor's Skill Deck or set by an agent.

smooth.doc: Smooth the path with a curve rather than straight segments.

sourceIn.doc: Source in point: where playback begins within the source, trimming the head.

sourceOut.doc: Source out point: where playback ends within the source.

spacing.doc: Distance between neighbours, px — the pitch of a line, grid, plane, sunflower or spiral.

speed.doc: Multiplies the animation's own clock; 1 is real time.

src.doc: Path, URL, asset id, or a `generate.*` declaration.
Path, URL, asset id, or a `generate.*` declaration.
Path to a Lottie JSON in the project, or an imported asset.

stagger.doc: How far apart the group's children's motion runs, as a `Time`.
Time between one unit starting and the next.
Time between one copy's animation and the next.

staggerOrder.doc: Which copy goes first when staggered.

start.doc: Parent-timeline time at which the node begins.
When the line appears, in scene-local time.

syncTo.doc: `id` of another element carrying an audio track.

target.doc: `id` of the element that gets quieter.

textAlign.doc: Horizontal alignment of glyphs within the box.

textBaseline.doc: Vertical alignment within the box: the block anchored to the top or bottom of the box or centered, or ("alphabetic") the first line's baseline at the top of the box.

textCase.doc: Casing applied when drawing; the text itself is left as written.

textColor.doc: Text color used by built-in diagram labels.

tiltY.doc: Camera yaw, degrees — keyframe it to spin a sphere.

time.doc: Node-local time: 0 is where the clip begins (its `start`).
Where the marker sits, in scene-local time.

transition.doc: Transition into the next clip, rendered centered on the cut, set on the outgoing clip.

trimOffset.doc: Rotates the window around the figure, in turns.

trimStart.doc: Where the drawn part begins, 0–1 of the whole figure.

uniforms.doc: Values for the shader's `@group(1)` uniform declarations, matched by name: numbers bind to `f32`, arrays of 2-4 to `vec2f`-`vec4f`, CSS color strings to `vec3f`/`vec4f`.

upscale.doc: Resolution multiplier: 2 asks for twice the pixels.

value.doc: The amount: px for "blur", "chromaticAberration" and "directionalBlur", degrees for "hueRotate", 0–2 for "glow", 0–1 otherwise.
The value at `time`: a number, any CSS color on a `color` track, or path data on a `d`/`path` track.
Its value: a CSS color, a string for a text slot, or a number.

verticalAlign.doc: Vertical placement of the caption block: anchored to the top or bottom safe margin, or centered.

volume.doc: Decibels on the scene's own bus, which everything in it mixes into: the master fader.
Decibels: 0 = unity gain, negative attenuates (-6 ≈ half as loud), -Infinity = silence.

wgsl.doc: Fragment-stage WGSL, applied to the video/image paint directly below it in the paint stack, or run procedurally (over a transparent source) when there is none.

workarea.doc: The stretch of the scene that plays and exports, as `[in, out]`: playback loops within it, and an export is of it and nothing else — so this is where a render is trimmed.

x.doc: Position relative to the parent, px.

zoom.doc: Scales the positions and the copies together.
